about_the_game:
The Aquarium does not dance Special Edition Release Celebration Character Talk DLC (SP edition)

  

To show our appreciation, our team has put together this free Character Talk DLC available for everyone who downloads The Aquarium does not dance.

This bonus content DLC was written by daidai specially for the release of TADND Special Edition for Steam and Nintendo Switch™. Enjoy some light-hearted banter between the characters of The Aquarium does not dance that you won't find anywhere else!

This DLC also features special illustrations of the five heroines in pajamas and swimwear that were initially revealed at Comiket. We hope you enjoy their cute beach and slumber party banter!

 

 

■How to View the DLC

This DLC is provided as a PDF file.

Please view it with your preferred PDF viewer.

The files are located in the "AquadoDLC_SP" folder

within the main game directory, with versions available in each language.

Open your library and right-click on the "Aquarium Never Dances Special Edition" icon.

From the menu that appears, select "Manage."

Choose "Browse Local Files."

Open the "AquodoDLC_sp" folder and view the PDF with your browser or PDF viewer.
